title: A 2-Year-Old Website Sold for $1.65 Billion #shorts
description:
In October two thousand six, Google bought YouTube for one point six five billion dollars in stock, less than two years after it launched.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
first_comment: Did YouTube's founders sell too cheap, or was one point six five billion a steal for them? 👇

lines.text: A two-year-old website sold for one point six five billion dollars.
And its first video was nineteen seconds at a zoo.
In two thousand five, three former PayPal employees launched YouTube, a site where anyone could upload video.
Within a year, it was serving about one hundred million videos a day.
But it was burning cash, and making almost no money.
In October two thousand six, Google paid one point six five billion dollars in stock.
All from a site whose first video was nineteen seconds at a zoo.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
